% --- latex-dual-layer macros (auto-generated) ---
\newlength{\dlboxwidth}
\newlength{\dlboxheight}
\newlength{\dlboxdepth}
\newcommand{\duallayerbox}[2]{%
  \begingroup
  \settowidth{\dlboxwidth}{\strut #1}%
  \settoheight{\dlboxheight}{\strut #1}%
  \settodepth{\dlboxdepth}{\strut #1}%
  \ifdim\dlboxwidth=0pt
    \settowidth{\dlboxwidth}{#2}%
  \fi
  \raisebox{0pt}[\dlboxheight][\dlboxdepth]{%
    \makebox[\dlboxwidth][l]{\resizebox{\dlboxwidth}{!}{\strut #2}}%
  }%

\section*{True / False (26 marks)}
\textit{Answer True or False and justify briefly.}
\begin{enumerate}[label=\arabic*.]
\item True or False: The correct answer to 'Applications developed by programming languages like \_\_\_\_ and \_\_\_\_\_\_ have this common \duallayerbox{buffer-overflow error}{memory leak issue}.' is 'C, C++'.
\item True or False: The correct answer to 'When a wireless user authenticates to any AP, both of them go in the course of \duallayerbox{four-step authentication progression}{two-step verification} which is called...' is 'wireless handshaking'.
\item True or False: The correct answer to 'In MD-5 the length of the message digest is' is '\duallayerbox{128}{256}'.
\item True or False: The correct answer to 'What are the port states determined by Nmap?' is '\duallayerbox{Open, filtered, unfiltered}{Closed, filtered, open}'.
\item True or False: The correct answer to 'Can a stream cipher have perfect secrecy?' is 'No, since the key is \duallayerbox{shorter than the message}{equal to the message}'.
\item True or False: The correct answer to 'Which of the following is not an example of \duallayerbox{presentation layer issues}{network layer issues}?' is 'Weak or non-existent authentication mechanisms'.
\item True or False: The correct answer to 'What tool can be used to perform SNMP enumeration?' is '\duallayerbox{IP Network Browser}{Wireshark}'.
\item True or False: The correct answer to 'A session symmetric key between two parties is used' is '\duallayerbox{Only once}{Multiple times}'.
\item True or False: The correct answer to 'Man in the middle attack can endanger the security of Diffie Hellman method if two parties are not' is '\duallayerbox{Joined}{Authenticated}'.
\item True or False: The correct answer to 'How is IP address spoofing detected?' is '\duallayerbox{Comparing the TTL values}{Checking the IP headers} of the actual and spoofed addresses'.
\item True or False: The correct answer to 'Which of the following is not a block cipher operating mode?' is '\duallayerbox{CBF}{CBC}'.
\item True or False: The correct answer to 'The message must be encrypted at the sender site and decrypted at the' is '\duallayerbox{Sender Site}{Receiver Site}'.
\item True or False: The correct answer to 'What does EXE do when the STP solver times out on a constraint query for a particular path?' is '\duallayerbox{Assume that the query is not satisfiable}{Retry the query} and stop executing the path'.
\end{enumerate}
